name: pm51-input-filter
summary: PM51: with a fixed input, a source wake from the front-end (event 9) wakes the monitor only if the selected input is active; "Select Automatically" unchanged (LG 28MQ780 behaviour)

edits.asm: bank-0 free space 0xA140: filt (event 9: hide suppressed ports from 0x69B3; no unsuppressed match -> drop the event)
classifier event-9 path: lcall 0x69B3 -> lcall filt

notes: Addresses are PM51 code addresses (bank 0, package offset 0x10080 + addr). Uses the stock suppress list XDATA 0x5E81+port (filled at the standby request from settings +0x4F) and the front-end id table XDATA 0x6202+port. Event 9 with mask 0, events other than 9 and automatic input behave as stock. Generated by tools/patches_src_pm51_input_filter.py.
